analysis: The PR changes only docs/developer/test.md, with three documentation edits: the 'Last updated' date (line 3), the CI shard-routing description (head lines 99-101) and the darkbloom-route test description (head lines 1346-1349). These add that each provider test shard routes through its own lane, test-provider-K, and that the route test pins one lane per provider shard, matching the job's matrix. No source, workflow, protocol, key-handling, attestation or cache code is modified. I found no change to any threat-model asset, trust boundary or mitigation (TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-011, T-041 and others). The surrounding unchanged text describes tests and release gating, including the dev-branch lane, DEV_* secrets and Apple signing secrets read only in the signing job. It is not part of this diff and I did not evaluate it as a new regression. Both units were examined. One integration question remains outside the supplied evidence: the actual CI routing workflow and the scripts/test-darkbloom-route.py implementation are not supplied. The new text asserts per-shard lanes and read-only permissions, so a later pass should confirm that the real workflow matches this documentation, that routed jobs keep read-only permissions and that release workflows stay on literal runners. This documentation alone introduces no security regression.
